entities.summary: Reshanda Gray is an American professional basketball player who plays both in the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and internationally. She played college basketball for the California Golden Bears and was named the Pac-12 Conference Player of the Year as a senior in 2015. She was drafted by the Minnesota Lynx in the 2015 WNBA draft.
